main_text.p: Liber Dei, seu Gratiæ, Sapientiæ & Gubernationis diuinæ Exod.32.33.34.Psal.139.16.Esai.34.16.Dan.7.10. Malac. 3.16. Apoc. 20.12.]
[Liber, contractus, Syngrapha, Tabellæ emptionis, Ierem.32.10.&c.Epistola, literæ, Esai.37.14.& 39.1. Ierem.29. 25.29. Artes & scientiæ liberales, Dan.1.17.

LIBRORVM quorundam sacrorum catalogus, qui interciderunt. Liber bellorum Domini, Numer.21.14. Liber Iusti, Ios.10.13. alij librum recti interpretantur, hoc est, librum forensium annalium, siue actorum publicorum, qui interciderunt, vt alij multi forenses, quorum Scriptura meminit. Liber Nathan, 2. Paral. 9.29. 1. Par.29.29. liber Gad, ibid. liber Semeiæ. 2. Par. 12. 15. liber Haddo, 9.29. & 12.15. liber Ahiæ, 9.29. liber Iehu filij Hanani, 20.34.

LIBERI recte, & ex Dei verbo instituendi, Exod.12.24. & 13.14. Daniel 4.9.& 6.3.10.&9.3.&c. Liberi castigandi, Prou. 22.15.& 23.v.13.14. Ephes.6.4. humaniter fouendi, ibidem. Idolis non sacrificādi, Leuit.20.2.& 18.21. Deu.18.10. in vtero sanctificati, 1. Co.7.14. Liberi non ex æquo à parentibus dilecti. Exempla: Esau & Iacob, Gen.25.28. Ioseph & alij fratres, 37.3.

LIBERORVM erga parentes officium. Ephes. 6.1.2.3. Primum debent amorem. Exempla: Ioseph, Genesis 46.29 Elisæus, 1. Regum 19.20. Discipulus quidam, Matth.8.21. Secundo honorem. Exod.20.12. Exempla: Sem & Iapheth, Genes. 9.23. Ioseph, 46.29. & 48.12. Salomon, 1. Regum 2.19. Patlus & Hebraei, Hebr.12.9. Tertio, obedientiam. Col.3.20. Pro.23.22. Exempla: Isaac, Genes.22.v.6.&c. Iacob. 28.v.1.2. Ioseph, 37.v.13.14. Filia Iephte, Iudic.11.v.36.37. Samuel. 1. Sam.1,24.& 2.26. Salomon, 1. Reg.2.20. Rechabitę, Ierem. 35.v.18.19. Christus, Luc.2,51. Idem præcipit & Paulus fieri, Ephes.6.1. Coloss.3.20. Quarto, nutritionem. 1. Tim.5.4. Pro.28.24. Exemplum: Ioseph. Genes.45.v.9.10.11. Christus, Ioh.19.26.27. Minæ in contumaces, Deut.21.18. Exod.21, 15.& 17. Matth.15.4. Prou.19 26.& 30.17.

Liberorum contumaciæ & inobedientiæ erga parentes exempla: Cham, Gen.9.22. Esau, 26.v.34.35.& 28.v.8.9 Simeon & Leui, 34.30. Heli filij, Ophni & Phinees, 1. Sam. 2.v.22.23.24. Filij Samuelis, 8.3. Absalom, 2. Sam.16,v.1.2.3 4. Filius prodigus, Luc.15.v.11 12. ¶ Liberorum procreatio donum Dei est, Gen.1.28.& 4.v.1.25.& 16, 2, & 20.v.17.18.
